title: Where can I find data for futures ?
author: Zenitshu18
selftext:
Hey Guys, I have been building an algorithm with claude code for my strategy to automate my trades. The bottle neck i find is the data to back test , However I have a plus subscription on trading view it is limited to 10,000 candels and my algo works on 5 min or 1min. 

Does anyone know the best place to get them for less price ? Or may be free ? 🙃🫠 if that even exists?

comments.author: Must_Dragonfruit
comments.body: i'm sharing futures on my site, you can pull them from my api for free for the next six months. If there's data missing you need, just email me.

replies.author: Must_Dragonfruit
replies.body: check my profile, it's on there, don't want to spam

comments.author: MyLinedChart
comments.body: If you’re trading on 1 and 5 min candles what do you need 10000+ candles for? At that low of a time frame historical data beyond the last few days/weeks is irrelevant

replies.author: Zenitshu18
replies.body: System analysis is done in the HTF level and entries are taken in LTF , so That why i need it.

replies.author: MyLinedChart
replies.body: Interesting. I’d have to know more so this probably isn’t helpful: sounds like a time frame miss match. If you’re using higher TFs as the signal for entry, then lower TFs down to 1 min shouldn’t make much of a difference. Either way 😇

replies.author: Zenitshu18
replies.body:
I am focusing only on futures account. The  trades are not allowed to keep overnight. 

HTF 4H , 6H looks promising for trade but wont be possible and profitable for a daytrade. So I switch to 5 Min, 1 Min. 

When I have the 1 Min data it will be easier the system accumulates the 1 min data to build the HTF data itself but vice versa not possible. So I can have both data if I have LTF data.

To clarify you , I Use HTF only for market analysis and LTF data to enter the trade.🙂
